document.issuer: US Department of Defense, from the Defense Logistics Agency's ASSIST
document.title: General Guidelines for Electronic Equipment

scope: guideline 69, 4.1, page 69-1: clearance between solder connections or bare conductors, such as on terminal strips, standoffs, or similar connections; a handbook for guidance (cover page)

condition.where: guideline 69, 4.2a to c, page 69-1: A, a short circuit limited to the unit and at most 50 W; B, fused and at most 2000 W; C, fused and over 2000 W

enclosure.where: guideline 69, 4.2d and e, page 69-1: I, no drop or particle from 0 to 15 degrees off the vertical can enter; II, any enclosure that protects less

voltage: guideline 69, table 69-I, page 69-2: voltage ac (rms) or dc

creepage.where: guideline 69, 4.1 page 69-1; table 69-I, leakage distances, page 69-2

not_judged: guideline 69, table 69-I, page 69-2: a voltage over 1000 V
guideline 69, page 69-1 and 69-2: a slot cut to lengthen a path; the handbook states no least width for one
